snippet.title: (OUTDATED) Tomo The Wildcat - Trailer (Azumanga Daioh Fangame)
snippet.description:
NEW TRAILER: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mNNox3tDEKk
New release date: July 25th, 2025
Download demo here: https://lukasatbk.itch.io/tomo-the-wildcat

Presenting Tomo The Wildcat, a 2D platformer inspired on Azumanga Daioh and Sonic Generations, this game contains 7 main levels, 10 side-levels, multiple playable characters, game modes, and more!

Support me on Patreon for exclusive content! https://patreon.com/LukasATBK

Twitter: https://x.com/LukasATBK
Website: https://lukasatbk.neocities.org/

Music from Azumanga Donjyara Daioh
